scope: Read-only derived context for two independent 18k trials. This does not reclassify frozen results or establish a unique cause of scheduler lateness. No CSV/analyzer/network/JVM run.
limitations: 1Hz resource samples cannot identify millisecond-scale thread stalls.
UTC arrival origins are approximate; explicit enclosing sample overshoot is retained.
Process CPU utilization does not measure host scheduling pressure or invisible cgroup ancestors.
No GC/JFR/thread scheduling traces or load-driver CnC are present.
Counter absence is unavailable/null, never inferred zero.

arrivalWindow.scope: Per-trial Java approximate UTC origin; no assumption that different trials share an origin. Whole load-process lifetime includes validation and is not this window.

trials.clientTransportScope: Unaccepted offer attempts may be retried locally; not a count of lost business commands. No client-driver CnC attribution.

coverage.scope: Enclosing observed sample bracket; includes the declared lead/overshoot. Not an interpolated exact arrival-window measurement.

sampleMetadata.scope: Only explicit node-0/1/2 identity records and optional load identity record. cgroup counters describe the sampler's current visible v1/v2 leaves, not their hidden ancestors. Network counters describe the sampler's network namespace, not individual processes. Raw counters are cumulative; use monotonic deltas for rates. Null/errors are unavailable, not zero. CPU ticks use clockTicksPerSecond; status *Bytes/io *_bytes/network bytes are bytes; rchar/wchar are bytes; syscr/syscw are syscall counts; v2 cpu.stat *_usec are microseconds. v1 cpu.stat throttled_time/burst_time and cpuacct.usage are nanoseconds; v1 cpuacct.stat user/system are USER_HZ ticks. memory.failcnt is allocation failures, not OOM kills. Wall clocks are not verified synchronized and do not establish one-way latency.

load.scope: Aggregate process CPU ticks / CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed; cores consumed, not a percent of an assumed host allocation.

node-0.scope: Aggregate process CPU ticks / CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed; cores consumed, not a percent of an assumed host allocation.

cgroup.scope: Sampler-visible cgroup leaf; hidden ancestors/host scheduling are not measured. Leaf cpu.max=max and zero throttle do not exclude other restrictions.

network.scope: UDP counters cover the sampler network namespace; device counters cover lo. Neither attributes packets to one process.

coverage.scope: Enclosing observed sample bracket; includes the declared lead/overshoot. Not an interpolated exact arrival-window measurement.

metadata.scope: All currently allocated CnC counters. Values may be cumulative totals or gauges; interpret their type and label. Counter registrations and labels can change or be reused. No error-log messages or environment variables are read. CnC PID and heartbeat are observations, not process ownership validation.
